itemdesc-minecart: A vehicle for traveling along rails. Right click a minecart rail to place, then right click the minecart to ride it or exit it. Hold shift while right clicking to pick it up again.
itemdesc-minecart-drill:
A minecart that can drill through terrain and place rails as it goes (drawing from player inventory)

CNTL + Right Click to toggle drill mode on/off
itemdesc-minecart-lighted: A minecart with a light attached. Right click a minecart rail to place, then right click the minecart to ride it or exit it. Hold shift while right clicking to pick it up again.
itemdesc-minecart-storage:
A minecart with storage space. Right click a minecart or storage minecart on a rail to attach the storage minecart to it.

Right click to access storage.
